decode_layout: input = 1 * i32 little-endian (4 bytes) => `val`, the sole argument of the original benchmark's provable fn `alloc(val: i32) -> u32`. Short input (<4 bytes) returns an empty Vec. Output = u32 little-endian (4 bytes); the lifted body always returns 0 after asserting the C-allocated value round-trips.
entry_called: lifted body of malloc benchmark's `alloc(val)`: extern "C" `alloc_and_set(val)` then `assert_eq!(*ptr, val)` then `free_me(ptr)` (malloc/free via jolt-sdk malloc-shim)
